name: deckthing
description: A modular DIY stream deck interface

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix electron-builder install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.engine: node scripts/python.js --cwd server -m PyInstaller --onefile --noconsole --name macro macro.py
scripts.package: npm run engine && npm run build && npm --prefix electron-builder run build-win
